name: Harvest Shoot
description: An autumn field where cartoon chickens fly across and a crosshair plays the game by itself: it aims, leads, misses, hits, reloads. The time is the round timer, the steps are the score.

steps.script: const n = project.elements.length; ['Hour','Colon','Minute'].forEach((nm,i)=>{ project.elements[n-3+i].name = nm + ' Aod'; }); return 1

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gBirds = 'Chickens'; project.groups.gFx = 'Feathers and popups'; project.groups.gAmmo = 'Shells'; project.groups.gSign = 'Clock sign'; for (const e of project.elements) if (/^(Wooden stake sign|Hour|Colon|Minute)$/.test(e.name)) e.group = 'gSign'; let n = 0; for (const e of project.elements) { if (/^Chicken \d/.test(e.name)) { e.group = 'gBirds'; n++ } if (/^(Feather|Popup)/.test(e.name)) { e.group = 'gFx'; n++ } if (/^Shell/.test(e.name)) { e.group = 'gAmmo'; n++ } } return n
